question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as public core config/plugin API, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still expose one exclusive memory slot, but changing it adds durable public config, plugin runtime, per-agent override, doctor migration, and documentation obligations that automation should not decide.

options.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
options.body: Treat the open PR as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow the taxonomy first
options.body: Keep this issue open as design work and ask the PR to stage, rename, or reduce role slots before any public config surface lands.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide memory composition should stay outside core or use a different plugin API shape.

recommendation.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.
